race.comment: DATA LEAK (6) is the top choice despite two lackluster recent runs, as the setup is easier than in Class 3 at Eagle Farm. He was overlooked there and showed no change of gears, but his profile still rates well for this field, and he handles wet tracks fine. The class relief could spark a rebound. SWITCH TO GO (9) won first-up at Gatton in a CG BM58 and he has two wins from four tries at this distance. The jump to BM62 is a test, but he's lightly raced, fitter second-up, and retains the winning rider with a claim. REDCLOUD (10) has solid recent form after closing well in a BM65 at Toowoomba, despite a bump. He won his only 1500m run, and Gary Geran rides well. AIRSWING (7) is a last-start Class 3 winner with weight relief and enough 1500m form to be competitive. Include.
